pay_detail: Paid summer internship; rate not stated
duration: Summer 2026 started June 29; length not stated
name: PROPEL Summer Research Internship
what_you_do: A paid summer internship in a UMass Lowell research lab. You work on real engineering or life science projects with teachers and student mentors. You learn lab skills and safety.
who_can_apply: You must be 16 or older when the internship starts. You must go to, or just have left, one of these. A trade high school under Chapter 74. A public or charter high school in a listed Gateway City, like Lowell, Lawrence, Worcester, Springfield, Lynn or Brockton. Or a public high school where 25% or more of students have low income.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications were due Feb 28, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Write a 250 word essay. Share something that shows your STEM interest, like a poster, slides, posts, a podcast or a video. Make a 1 minute video about yourself. Get a reference from a teacher. Questions: PROPEL@uml.edu.
notes: Eligibility depends on your school type or city. Check the Gateway City list on the apply page. Ask about a Massachusetts work permit.
